scope: Pilot on retained batch 1 only (50,000 simulations; 5% of full dataset)

grouping.method: Connected components of rounded temperature RMS <= 0.01 C within identical rounded power curves
grouping.scope: All 50,000 pilot rows; not all one million simulations

selection: Lowest validation macro RMSE divided by training target SD, across all six indicators
loss: Equal mean squared standardized log errors across all six indicators; HLC is derived from its two positive components
limitations: No building/configuration IDs; grouping nearby observable inputs cannot establish independent physical configurations.
Same heating protocols may occur in different splits with different temperature responses. This pilot estimates in-distribution performance, not unseen-protocol generalization.
Grouping threshold is an exploratory 0.01 C RMS criterion, not a proof of physical equivalence.
Sampling interval and boundary conditions remain unknown.
Single training seed and bounded epoch budget; this is not a final architecture ranking.
Used installed Python environment, not an independently uv-synchronized environment.
